answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before joining the economy, with the stake size rising along a steep ridge: the first identity is cheap, each additional one costs far more. Like a jade seal that only one holder can present, the deposit is bound to a verifiable hardware-backed key, so a single operator cannot split it across fake agents. A crystal-clear public ledger publishes each stake and slashes it when fraud is proven, turning a thousand fake identities from free into a ruinously expensive pile of locked deposits.
